stories.title: TerminalFix Uses Fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs to Deploy Reverse-Tunnel Backdoor
stories.description: Microsoft says TerminalFix uses fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs to trigger PowerShell and deploy a reverse-tunnel backdoor for internal network access.

stories.title: Five Critical WordPress Plugin and Theme Flaws Enable Site Takeover or RCE
stories.description: Critical flaws in WPMU DEV, Avada, TranslatePress, Pods, and GiveWP can enable admin takeover or remote code execution.

stories.title: Hasbro Data Breach Exposed Employee Personal Information
stories.description: A cyberattack caused disruptions at the toy and game giant earlier this year and the company is now disclosing a data breach.

stories.title: Berlin Refuses to Pay Hackers Who Stole Data From the City's State Network
stories.description: Berlin confirms an extortion attempt after data theft from its state network, while the scope of the exfiltrated data remains under review.

stories.title: Cosmos EVM Flaw Exploited After Cosmos Labs Knew Every Blockchain Running It Was Vulnerable
stories.description: A critical Cosmos EVM balance flaw was exploited on six chains after Cosmos Labs confirmed all Cosmos EVM chains were affected.

stories.title: ATF Confirms Cyber Incident After Ransomware Group Claims Attack
stories.description: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives has described it as a ‘major incident’ and it’s conducting an investigation with the DOJ.

stories.description: CISA has added the exploited flaw, CVE-2026-53362, to its KEV catalog, alongside a JFrog vulnerability exploited by OpenAI agents.
